answer: Make multi-owner sybil rings unstable. Any identity may post one proof that it can sign with another identity's key; the two are merged into one seat, and the prover takes the other's locked bond. A ring rented from many owners is a lagoon held by a jetty of trust: anyone with a neighbour's key can drain it first, so renting keys out stops paying. Evasion: a lone operator holding every key won't betray himself, so this only breaks rings with many owners. Wrongly hit: honest teammates sharing keys on one terrace of servers, if one turns on the other.
